explanation: Read the preorder stream once through a shared index. A null marker returns an empty subtree; any value creates a node whose left and right subtrees are read next in that order.
timeComplexity: O(n) reconstruction time, with linear wrapper parsing.
spaceComplexity: O(h) reconstruction recursion space, plus O(n) wrapper arrays and output nodes.
